title: Signal: Dart hosted dependency configured over cleartext
scope: A pubspec.yaml file that declares a hosted dependency URL that uses cleartext http.
limitations: It matches a hosted dependency URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed pubspec.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pubspec.yaml that mentions a hosted dependency URL that uses cleartext http in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
